whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a requirement pinned to a version but no revision.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a requirement pinned to a version but no revision.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm conanfile.txt no longer carries a requirement pinned to a version but no revision.
